findings.issue: Claims 'every moderate-inhibition arm sat below every interval-supported threshold'. Under the PRIMARY anchor the 1x arm at 480 mg/day clears 10% WITH interval support (16.0%, CI 11.4%-21.9%), contradicting §3.3 and §3.4. The claim holds only under the superseded 36-month anchor, which is the only anchor for which the 7x arm was ever run.
findings.fix: Restrict the regulatory-gradient claim to the superseded anchor and say so, or drop it
